channel.title: TWCERT/CC — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by TWCERT/CC (twcert).

item.title: CVE-2026-82181 · 6.8 MEDIUM — Le-yan｜Medical Practice Management System - Sensitive Data in URL
item.description: Medical Practice Management System developed by Le-yan has a Sensitive Data in URL vulnerability. Unauthenticated remote attackers can obtain sensitive information via victim's browser history or log files.
